_doc: Why each gate item left in the pilot bake is there and which task owns it (P1-017, MAP_REPAIR.md 'Verification': the seven gate counts (width steps since P1-046) are 0 or each item is explained in the report). tools/bake/report/gates.ts matches an entry to an item by its id (a strip end 'w<way>.<piece>_<n> start|end', a map edge node 'm<way>.<n>', a face pair 'a|b'; '*' stands for a number, since zone numbers change with any map change: 'w1.0_0|zone_merge_*') or by its kind. An item no entry explains stops the bake before tiles are written (invariant GATES-01). Entries that match nothing in a bake are listed in health.json gateReport.idle: delete them once their owner fixed the item. findings lists known defects outside the six gates with their owners, copied into health.json gateReport.findings.

explanations.why: a junction lies within its own cut length (up to 18 m, the cluster rule) of the pilot stage outline, so the lane model takes the map edge node into the junction (or keeps a stub) instead of ending the road at the outline. The pilot outline is a stage edge inside the centre block, not a block or map edge: the next stage bake carries these roads on. The real map edge gets closures (gate, loop, barricade) when the whole block is baked.

explanations.owner: explained (lane model): under what a player sees
explanations.why: hairline overlaps of 0.02 to 0.03 m2 where a one-way link meets the road it joins at a shallow angle (a link onto Sikandra Road near Mandi House, a link into a merge zone in Old Delhi): the kerb rows of the two strips cross over a few centimetres. Over the 0.01 m2 pair limit, far under anything a player sees. Since P1-046 Kela Ghat Marg can be a third: the slip road w77617230.1 takes the first section of its merge zone whole (three lanes, the zone tapers are 1:20 now) and the carriageway beside it lies about 0.5 m2 on the zone where the two meet at a shallow angle, on the solved levels only. A fourth hairline (0.03 m2) lies where a service road meets Tolstoy Marg south of CP at a shallow angle.

findings.what: ITO ramps against the Phase 0 profile
findings.measured: 0.31 to 1.46 m mid ramp on four ramps, decks within 0.13 m; explained (P1-035): with the Phase 0 merge zone starts imposed (the block lane model starts the two merges 30 m and 56 m later) and the slip road under the loop ramp lowered 0.43 m as Phase 0 did (the solver holds it, 0.15 m), every one of 463 points is within 0.29 m
findings.owner: explained, decisions.md 2026-11-13 (no fix: both are rules of the block lane model and the solver)

findings.what: roads under short ramp flyovers sunk
findings.measured: Geeta Colony 0.88 m (was 4.0, fixed in P1-035: the slip ramp goes on past the stage edge). Hanuman Mandir was 1.72 m, the centre of the Kashmere Gate 11-arm cluster held down by its tunnel arm cut 157 m out: under 0.5 m since the cluster was split (P1-042). The most now is 0.97 m (the unnamed deck over Mahatma Gandhi Marg, the Ring Road and the railway). P1-037: S25 (the service deck over Barron Road, 0.97 m) and S28 (Vikas Marg after the ITO three-way split, 0.76 m) have every ramp at its class grade limit (service 8, primary 5, its slip 6 percent): the clearance is a hard limit, so the solve lowers the road under them
findings.owner: explained: every one is 1 m or less; under 0.5 m needs longer ramps than OSM draws (a hero road spec)

findings.what: junction clusters with no usable ring, oversize junction surfaces and lane paths off the road
findings.measured: 80 clusters with no usable ring (J2). Until P1-042 turns across a long cluster asked for cuts of 90 percent of an arm, edges up to 297 m became part of the junction and three clusters grew to 18,253, 14,038 and 5,985 m2 (Kashmere Gate twice, and a knot of streets north of Connaught Place); about 57 km of their lane paths ran off every road face. Now a turn asks for 30 m at most, an arm is cut back 60 m at most to come clear of another, a fork's crotch is a nose and no edge of 45 m or more is taken in for a turn: 5 surfaces are over 3,000 m2 (the largest about 5,800 m2, each listed with why in health.json mesh.oversize). Lane paths keep to the roads inside a cluster where their arcs looped or ran far from them (roads/routes.ts). Since P1-043 each path is the one of the arc, the path along the roads (four corner tolerances) and the direct path that stays most on the junction's planned ring, and a cluster whose paths along its roads still leave the ring by over 2 m is built by the polygon set: 0.2 km of 396 km of path is on no road face (health.json mesh.paths; 10.5 km in P1-042), and 74 arm pairs turn under 4 m (15 in P1-042), each in health.json lanes.paths.tight with its reason (the corners of old city lanes the path follows)
findings.owner: explained (P1-043): paths that follow a lane's own corners

findings.what: tunnel mouths: the face between the ground over the roof and the roof where an open ramp meets its roofed part
findings.measured: a headwall at each of 24 mouths (one at a joint of a cut strip and a tunnel strip, two under a road at grade over the roof): 0 open faces at 88 road edges across them (health.json terrain.portals, TERR-07)

the pilot has no drain areas: drain, ditch, stream and canal lines are channels now, and 7 running water bodies (12,200 m2) follow the slope of their banks (0.5 to 5 m per km, up to 1.4 m of fall; health.json terrain.drains). Ponds, the Kartavya Path canals and the Yamuna stay flat
findings.owner: fixed (P1-037); the water network with flow, joins and culverts is P2-030

findings.what: road edge with no ground along it (another road face lies there)
findings.measured: 125 m (642 m in P1-015, 399 m before P1-037): road faces of one level within a centimetre of each other, a raised corner band beside its junction surface or two kerbs side by side, with a hairline gap or overlap of 2 to 10 mm the conform step does not weld; the road covers both sides, so no ground is missing. The 0.3 m wide band slivers that made most of it are left out since P1-037 (health.json terrain.gap.underRoad lists the places)

a raised kerb 0.45 m deep across every dead end at grade (717 of 737 on the pilot; 10 raised or lowered ends and 10 with another face in the way keep a square end; health.json mesh.endKerbs). 90 raised corner pieces the polygon set cut to slivers under 0.6 m are left out
